abstract.para: This section defines the update policy and lifecycle strategy for core security components in the &suselinux; 16 codestream.

section.title: Stable security components
section.para: These components remain the same within a minor release. New versions are typically introduced only with the next minor release.

listitem.para: The version is fixed for FIPS 140-3 certification within the minor release.

Kerberos authentication protocol implementation; maintained with bug and security fixes within the minor release.
Hardware authentication middleware and libraries (such as OpenSC, pcsc-lite, and libfido2); maintained with bug and security fixes within the minor release.
Integrity Measurement Architecture management utilities; maintained with bug and security fixes within the minor release.
PKCS#11 implementation for hardware security modules; maintained with bug and security fixes within the minor release.
Modern file encryption tool and Rust implementation of the age format; maintained with bug and security fixes within the minor release.
Digital signature utility and Rust implementation of minisign; maintained with bug and security fixes within the minor release.
Pluggable Authentication Modules and PolicyKit authorization framework; maintained with bug and security fixes within the minor release.

section.title: Balanced security components
section.para: These components can be updated with a maintenance update or receive a version update with a new minor release.

listitem.para: Updated with compatible minor and patch releases during maintenance updates or new minor releases.
Policies are updated with monthly snapshots.
Initial versions establish the baseline for FIPS 140-3 evaluation. Maintenance updates align with Firefox ESR releases to deliver compatible security and protocol updates.
New versions are typically introduced with a new minor release.
Updated with compatible point releases during maintenance updates or new minor releases.
Trusted Platform Module software stack and utilities; updated with compatible point releases during maintenance updates or new minor releases.
